name: eml-viewer
description: Open .eml, .emlx and .mbox email files in VS Code. See the HTML with remote images blocked, attachments, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results and the delivery route. Offline.

emlViewer.maxMessageMB.description: Largest single message (an .eml file or one message of a mailbox) that is parsed, in MB. Mailbox files can be up to 4 GB.

emlViewer.alwaysShowRemoteImages.description: Load remote images in HTML messages without asking. Off by default: a remote image can tell the sender that you opened the message.

emlViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used EML Viewer for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

emlViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links in the status line of the viewer. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with EML Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Read saved email and mailbox files in VS Code, offline.

steps.title: Open an email file
steps.description:
Click a .eml, .emlx, .mbox or .mbx file in the Explorer. HTML mail opens with remote images blocked.
[Find an email file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.eml%22%5D)

media.altText: A newsletter .eml in EML Viewer with the header card, SPF, DKIM and DMARC badges and the HTML body.

steps.title: Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC and the route
steps.description: The Authentication tab lists the results the receiving server recorded. The Route tab shows each Received hop with its delay.

steps.title: Browse a mailbox
steps.description:
A .mbox file opens as a list you can search and sort. Pick a message to read it in the same view.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22emlViewer%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
